newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean listed firms' net profit down sharply.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean listed firms' net profit down sharply.

text.p: The combined net profit of South Korea's listed companies fell 61.4 percent in calendar 1996, while their combined sales rose 16.3 percent, the Securities Supervisory Board said in a report on Friday.
The board said their net profit plunged to a combined 3.83 trillion won in 1996 from 9.91 trillion a year earlier, while their sales rose to 37.64 trillion won from 32.37 trillion.
The figures were based on income statements filed with the stock market by 533 listed companies that closed books at the end of December, the board said.
The combined net profit of manufacturing firms fell 75.2 percent, compared with a 41.1 percent drop in the combined net profit of non-manufacturing firms excluding financial firms.
The report said 238 companies, or 44.7 percent of the 533 firms, saw their net profit increase on the year in 1996 while the net profit of 295 firms, or 55.3 percent, fell.
The board did not give further analysis of the results.
